label: Heavy going
summary: Climate diplomacy and markets both stumbled. COP31 in Antalya collapsed after two days of overtime, with the EU and others rejecting a text that omitted fossil fuels. Asian stocks opened sharply lower after Friday's 3.7% S&P 500 fall, though losses narrowed, US futures rose and oil eased. Russian strikes killed at least 15 in Ukraine, which is short of Patriot interceptors. Iranian media reported two tankers ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz, and drones killed four in Khartoum. Fighting drove Ebola workers into shelter in DR Congo, where the outbreak's toll has passed 5,600. Indonesia confirmed 24 dead in a factory fire, and a storm in southern Brazil killed five. Medicine and science offered modest relief: early results for a blood-pressure drug and whale genomes sequenced from breath. The weighted formula gave 36; no editorial adjustment.
